## Change

Tell what changes and why.

## Conformance

- [ ] I changed the status of a feature in `conformance/features.yaml`, or this change has no effect on a feature.
- [ ] A new `pass` has a check that compares the result with a direct SQL query on the demo ClickHouse.
- [ ] I did not weaken a check or narrow a feature to make a check pass.

## Commit messages

- [ ] The pull request title follows Conventional Commits. Release notes come from it.
